title: Wizard and Cosmic Dragon
description: A cheerful, bearded dwarf-like wizard in a multicolored patchwork robe sits on a stone courtyard, gesturing with one hand as magical sparkles emanate around him. Above him, a large ethereal blue dragon with a glowing green crescent moon coils through a vibrant circular mandala containing four ornate female faces, surrounded by abundant pink and purple flowering plants on stone steps.
prompt: A joyful round-bellied wizard with a long brown beard wearing a bright patchwork robe sits on stone pavement in an old courtyard, raising one hand to conjure magic. A majestic blue serpentine dragon with a glowing green crescent moon and four ornate female faces inside a colorful circular mandala floats above him. Lush pink and purple flowers overflow from stone planters and stairs, soft sunlight illuminates the scene, highly detailed fantasy illustration.
